model_inference: none; deterministic soccer extension commands only (actual Pi process and lifecycle are exercised)

cases.name: extension_load

assertions.expected: Pi RPC get_commands includes soccer:status from this extension

cases.name: happy_path

assertions.expected: The actual /soccer:status command is handled and notifies that no API key is configured
